what_it_pays_for: Viewers pay a monthly fee for perks you set - badges, emoji, members-only posts and videos. It is recurring income from your existing audience rather than from advertisers, and it unlocks at the lower of the two Partner Program bars.

revenue_basis.unit: revenue per paying member per month
revenue_basis.note: A function of how many of your viewers convert to paying members and at what tier price, minus the platform's share. Conversion is not published for any channel.

additional_requirements_not_assessed: No active Community Guidelines strikes on the channel
The channel is in a country or region where the programme operates
A linked and approved payments account
A minimum age applies to fan-funding products; the source read here does not state it
